answer: Admission forms a recovery circle. Each seated member receives one hardware-backed shard of a newcomer's key and answers a quartz challenge once per round, for as many rounds as there are seats. Responses chain across rounds, reuse is void, and a member may hold only one shard per round, so entrant m requires m² signing slots. The ember ledger publishes commitments; a missed round reopens the circle. k entrants therefore consume 1²+...+k² ≈ k³/3 signing slots. Clones must multiply devices and strangers' signatures before reaching the ledge of standing.
